attribute.name: rowCount
attribute.description: Number of rows in the matrix

attribute.name: colCount
attribute.description: Number of columns in the matrix

attribute.name: componentMap
attribute.description: Map of coordinate keys (rX_cY) to custom Web Component tag names

attribute.name: captions
attribute.description: Column captions (String[], List, path notation, or 2D array)

attribute.name: readOnly
attribute.description: Global read-only flag for grid matrix

attribute.name: readOnlyCells
attribute.description: Per-cell or per-column read-only rule map or list (e.g. Map or JSON string)

attribute.name: cellStyles
attribute.description: Per-cell, per-column, or per-row CSS style rule map or JSON string
